description: Create a team tag (label) so feedback can be tagged with it by name in feedback_post and feedback_update. Reuse the team's labels when one fits; create one only when the user wants a new label. Idempotent: if a tag with the same name exists (case-insensitive), it is returned unchanged with created: false. Tags are shared by the whole team; call tags() first to reuse an existing one. Optional color (#RRGGBB).

team_id.description: Team to act in: the team.id an earlier result named. Omit for the team selected in the Flask app (which the user can switch at any time).

name: tag_create
title: Create a team tag
